mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (chat_room_id, sender_id, message_type, message, status, sent_at) VALUES (#{chatRoomId}, #{senderId}, #{messageType}, #{message}, #{status}, #{sentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT cm.id, cm.chat_room_id, cm.sender_id, u.nickname AS sender_nickname, cm.message_type, cm.message, cm.parent_message_id, cm.file_group_id, cm.status, cm.edited_at, cm.sent_at, cm.deleted_at, cm.created_at, cm.updated_at FROM chat_message cm INNER JOIN users u ON cm.sender_id = u.id WHERE cm.id = #{id} AND cm.deleted_at IS NULL AND cm.status = 'NORMAL'
